body:
Extracted card/project description editing from Editor while preserving the existing draft, autosave and conflict owner. Fixed title resizing that produced WebKit observer errors. Browser tests now distinguish pending writes from acknowledged writes and use the macOS WebKit keyboard-navigation shortcut.

The full local gate passes: 238 Rust, 110 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Release browser evidence covers all 18 Chromium suites across recorded runs, with six affected suites rechecked after the title fix, and focused WebKit editor, autosave, counters and input checks. The existing manual app was rebuilt/restarted and its HTTPS address verified; all 21 existing resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate were preserved.

Dependency advisory CI and source/package CI for the preceding diagnostics commit passed on GitHub. The original isolated crash-test failure remains unexplained after the bounded 24-run series; one intermediate WebKit navigation diagnostic also did not recur in a focused rerun. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open. Legacy workspace tag APIs and milestones are retained; their roles and possible cleanup boundaries are explained in progress/2026-09-29-stability-followup.md.

metadata.summary: Editor simplification and cross-browser verification completed
